_help: Pipeline switches. Claude reads this at the start of every run.
_youtube_upload: manual = you upload the YouTube files yourself (until the API audit passes); api = GitHub Actions uploads. verify-youtube switches this to manual by itself if YouTube locks the uploads
_dry_runs_left: runs that make everything but publish nothing; counts down to 0
_ab_test: off = one thumbnail, one title (Krishna, 11 Nov 2026). native = 3 title+thumbnail pairs for Test & Compare
_publish: on_finish, or a fixed IST time like 18:00 (needs youtube_upload = api)
_release_schedule: IST. Main first, then the Short next morning and the Reel next evening, so something goes out daily and the verticals link to a live main video (Krishna, 13 Nov 2026; from general India data, re-check with the channel's own Studio data after ~3 weeks). scripts/release_times.py <slug> gives the exact times. YouTube and Instagram post the Short/Reel at the same times.
_thumbnail_rules: Read before Stage 5 / A6. Overrides the skill: no KR in thumbnails, thumbnail text = the video title.
